title: Practical Design Patterns Guide
description: Runnable TypeScript order pipeline wiring five design patterns together: Strategy for shipping, Factory Method for notifiers, Observer for order events, Decorator for product fetch, and Command for undoable cancellations.
description_es: Pipeline de pedidos ejecutable en TypeScript que conecta cinco design patterns: Strategy para el envío, Factory Method para los notificadores, Observer para los eventos de pedido, Decorator para la búsqueda de productos y Command para cancelaciones reversibles.
